t: 克劳迪乌斯·席尔瓦努斯被指叛国,他宣布自己是罗马皇帝,反对君士坦丁堡二世.
te: Claudius Silvanus, accused of treason, proclaims himself Roman Emperor against Constantius II.
dz: 克劳迪乌斯·席尔瓦努斯被指叛国,他宣布自己是罗马皇帝,反对君士坦丁堡二世.
de: Claudius Silvanus, accused of treason, proclaims himself Roman Emperor against Constantius II.

t: 哈德良被宣布为罗马皇帝,在特拉扬死后两天.
te: Hadrian is proclaimed Roman emperor, two days after Trajan's death.
dz: 哈德良被宣布为罗马皇帝,在特拉扬死后两天.
de: Hadrian is proclaimed Roman emperor, two days after Trajan's death.

t: 达西亚西南部(现代罗马尼亚)成为罗马行省:罗曼·达西亚.
te: The south-western part of Dacia (modern Romania) becomes a Roman province: Roman Dacia.
dz: 达西亚西南部(现代罗马尼亚)成为罗马行省:罗曼·达西亚.
de: The south-western part of Dacia (modern Romania) becomes a Roman province: Roman Dacia.

t: 由亚美尼亚民族的后代和创始人海克所击败贝尔的传统日期.
te: Traditional date of the defeat of Bel by Hayk, progenitor and founder of the Armenian nation.
dz: 由亚美尼亚民族的后代和创始人海克所击败贝尔的传统日期.
de: Traditional date of the defeat of Bel by Hayk, progenitor and founder of the Armenian nation.

t: 由哥伦布前的几个中美文明,特别是玛雅人使用的"中美长相历"开始.
te: The Mesoamerican Long Count calendar, used by several pre-Columbian Mesoamerican civilizations, notably the Maya, begin…
dz: 由哥伦布前的几个中美文明,特别是玛雅人使用的"中美长相历"开始.
de: The Mesoamerican Long Count calendar, used by several pre-Columbian Mesoamerican civilizations, notably the Maya, begins.
